svg.title: Find a public fact or calculate an answer
svg.desc: The first job needs an original source. The second needs arithmetic on all the supplied rows. Opening hours. Open the museum’s own page. Find its hours for Saturday. Parking counts. One lot has 90 cars in 100 spaces. Another has 1 car in 10 spaces. Combined result. Add the cars and the spaces separately. 91 of 110 spaces are occupied, about 82.7 percent.
